title: ✈️ Missed Flight
aText: You arrived at the airport too late. Your flight has already left, and you have an important meeting tomorrow morning.
aGoal: Find a way to reach your destination tonight.
bText: The next available flight is tomorrow morning. There are very limited options.
bGoal: Help the passenger while following the airline's rules.
challenge: Try to find a solution that makes both people happy.

title: 🏨 Terrible Hotel Room
aText: You just checked in. The air conditioner doesn't work, there is no hot water, and your room is next to a noisy family.
bText: The hotel is almost completely full. There may not be another room available.
bGoal: Solve the problem without simply saying no.
challenge: Offer at least two possible solutions.

title: 📦 Broken Package
aText: You ordered an expensive gift online. It arrived damaged one day before your friend's birthday.
aGoal: Get a replacement or another solution.
bText: Company policy normally requires several days for replacements.
bGoal: Help the customer without breaking company policy.
challenge: Stay polite even when the other person becomes frustrated.

title: 💼 Job Interview
aText: You are hiring for a software company and need someone who communicates well and solves problems.
aGoal: Find out whether the candidate is suitable.
bText: You really want the job, but have limited professional experience.
bGoal: Convince the interviewer that you are worth hiring.
challenge: Answer: Why should I hire you instead of someone with more experience?

title: 🏠 Roommates
aText: You like a clean, quiet home and usually sleep early.
bText: You are social, invite friends over, and sometimes stay up late.
bGoal: Keep enjoying your lifestyle.
challenge: Together, create 5 house rules.

title: 🏖️ Vacation Plans
aText: You want a relaxing beach vacation and don't want to spend much money.
aGoal: Convince your friend to choose your plan.
bText: You want an exciting mountain adventure and don't mind spending more money.
bGoal: Convince your friend to choose your plan.
challenge: You have a total budget of $1,500. Agree on one final plan.

title: 🍕 Dinner Disaster
aText: You and your friend are choosing dinner. You want healthy food.
bText: You had a terrible day and really want pizza or burgers.
bGoal: Convince your friend.
challenge: You only have $20.

title: 🎁 The Wrong Gift
aText: Your friend gave you a gift you really don't like. You don't want to hurt their feelings.
bText: You spent a lot of time choosing the gift and believe they will love it.
bGoal: Find out whether they like it.
challenge: Nobody may directly say: I don't like it.

title: 📱 Lost Phone
aText: You lost your phone somewhere in a shopping mall. It contains important photos and information.
bText: Someone recently found a phone, but you're not sure if it is theirs.
bGoal: Ask questions to identify the owner.
challenge: Student B must ask at least 5 questions.

title: 🗺️ Lost Tourist
aText: You are visiting the city for the first time, are completely lost, and need to get to the train station.
bText: You know the area fairly well.
bGoal: Give clear directions and help the tourist.
challenge: The tourist must repeat the directions to check they understood.

title: 🛍️ Return the Product
aText: You bought headphones yesterday. They stopped working this morning.
bText: Company policy says refunds are only available within 24 hours.
bGoal: Follow policy while trying to help.
challenge: Try to reach a compromise.

title: 🏥 Doctor & Patient
aText: You have been feeling tired recently and don't know why.
bText: You need to ask questions before giving advice.
bGoal: Understand the patient's daily habits and situation.
challenge: Ask at least 5 follow-up questions.

title: 🐶 The Pet Problem
aText: You really want to get a dog and have wanted one for years.
bText: You don't want a pet; you think pets are expensive and difficult to care for.
bGoal: Explain why you disagree.
challenge: Find a compromise.

title: 💰 The $1,000 Decision
aText: You and your friend received $1,000. You want to spend it on travel.
aGoal: Agree on how to spend the money.
bText: You want to buy a new computer.
bGoal: Agree on how to spend the money.
challenge: You cannot simply split it 50/50.

title: 🎉 Plan a Party
aText: You are planning a birthday party and want lots of people.
bText: You prefer a small, quiet celebration.
bGoal: Create a great party together.
challenge: With $300, decide where, who, food, music, and activities.

title: 🏫 Change the School
aText: You think students should be allowed to use phones during breaks.
bText: You think phones should be completely banned at school.
bGoal: Create fair phone rules.
challenge: As student council members, make three rules both sides accept.

title: 💻 Work From Home
aText: You want to work from home three days a week.
bText: You prefer employees to work in the office.
bGoal: Protect productivity.
challenge: Reach an agreement.

title: 📅 Cancelling Plans
aText: You promised to meet your friend today, but suddenly have an important problem.
aGoal: Cancel without making your friend angry.
bText: You have been waiting for this meeting all week.
bGoal: Understand what happened and decide whether to reschedule.
challenge: The conversation must end with a new plan.

title: 🚗 Borrow My Car
aText: Your friend wants to borrow your car, but you don't really want to lend it.
bText: You need the car because you have an important appointment.
bGoal: Convince your friend to lend it to you.
challenge: Do not say yes or no without explaining why.

title: 🎬 Movie Night
aText: You want to watch a comedy.
bText: You want to watch a horror movie.
bGoal: Make a final decision together.
challenge: You have 10 minutes before the movie starts.

title: 🧹 Terrible Roommate
aText: Your roommate never cleans the kitchen.
aGoal: Talk to them without starting an argument.
bText: You think cleaning isn't very important.
bGoal: Explain your point of view.
challenge: Create a weekly cleaning schedule together.

title: 🧳 Lost Luggage
aText: Your luggage didn't arrive at the airport. It has clothes, a laptop charger, and important items inside.
bText: You need to collect information before you can help.
bGoal: Find the luggage and explain what happens next.
challenge: Student A must clearly describe the luggage.

title: 💵 Ask for a Raise
aText: You have been working hard and believe you deserve a salary increase.
bText: The company is currently trying to reduce expenses.
bGoal: Listen while protecting the company's budget.
challenge: The manager cannot simply say yes or no.

title: 🌴 Dream Vacation
aText: You want a luxury vacation.
bText: You want an adventurous backpacking trip.
bGoal: Plan the trip together.
challenge: You have $2,000 and 7 days. Plan the entire trip.
